svg.aria-label: Two ways to get a certificate browsers trust on a local domain. If you own a public domain: Nginx Proxy Manager uses a Cloudflare API token to add a TXT record, Let’s Encrypt checks that record with the DNS-01 challenge and issues a wildcard certificate for *.home.yourdomain.com, which renews itself and is trusted by every browser. With no public domain: mkcert -install creates a local certificate authority in your trust store, mkcert magic.mirror signs a cert and key for that name, and the CA has to be installed by hand on every phone, tablet and laptop. Let’s Encrypt won’t sign magic.mirror because .mirror isn’t a public suffix.
svg.text: API token adds a TXT record
